{{Quote|So how did you bring the ceiling down like that?''"<br />"''Ultrasonic vibrations along with the heat from my lasers. Not even ceramisteel can withstand the combination.|Den Dhur and I-5YQ|<ref name="CN1">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Ceramisteel''' was a material used in vehicle [[Hull/Legends|hull]] construction.<ref name="Corporate">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ceramisteel was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Corporate" /> It subsequently appeared in [[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight|''Jedi Twilight'']], [[Michael Reaves]]' [[2008]] first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' novel trilogy.<ref name="CN1" />
